_**User**_

@Path("/chat")
@Tag(name = "Chat", description = "Freeform AI chat with knowledge base and code search access")
public class ChatResource {

    @Inject
    ChatService chatService;

    @POST
    @Consumes(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
    @Produces(MediaType.SERVER_SENT_EVENTS)
    @RestStreamElementType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
    @Operation(
            operationId = "chat",
            summary = "Chat with the AI assistant",
            description = "Sends a freeform question to the AI and receives a real-time SSE stream. "
                    + "Claude will search the knowledge base, look up customer context, and search source code "
                    + "as needed before generating its response. "
                    + "Responses are formatted in Markdown and may include Mermaid diagrams. "
                    + "Each SSE data frame is a JSON object with a 'type' field: "
                    + "'text' (Markdown delta), 'tool_start', 'tool_end', 'done', or 'error'."
    )
    @RequestBody(
            required = true,
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ChatRequest.class))
    )
    @APIResponses({
            @APIResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "SSE stream of ChatEvent JSON objects"),
            @APIResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Missing or blank message")
    })
    public Multi<ChatEvent> chat(ChatRequest request) {
        if (request == null || request.message() == null || request.message().isBlank()) {
            throw new WebApplicationException(
                    Response.status(400)
                            .entity(Map.of("error", "message is required"))
                            .build()
            );
        }
        return chatService.chatStream(request);
    }
}

@Schema(description = "Freeform chat request to the AI assistant")
public record ChatRequest(
        @Schema(required = true, description = "The user's question or message",
                example = "Which team member is responsible for the payment service?")
        String message,

        @Schema(description = "Optional product ID to scope the assistant's knowledge",
                example = "myproduct-platform")
        String productId,

        @Schema(description = "Optional conversation ID for future multi-turn support")
        String conversationId
) {}

All done. Here's a summary of everything that was implemented:

**Packages installed:**
- `react-markdown`, `remark-gfm` — Markdown rendering with GFM (tables, strikethrough, etc.)

- `markdownComponents` — full custom renderer wired into `react-markdown`: headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, blockquotes, inline/block code, links
- `CodeBlock` — detects `language-mermaid` → delegates to `MermaidDiagram`, otherwise renders syntax-highlighted code with a language label bar using the `oneDark` Prism theme
- `ToolActivityBadge` — pulsing pill that appears during `tool_start` / disappears on `tool_end`
- `ProductSelector` — single `useQuery` to `GET /customer-registry/products`, flat dropdown with "All products" default
- `Chat` — POST+fetch SSE streaming with full event handling (`text`, `tool_start`, `tool_end`, `done`, `error`), auto-growing textarea, auto-scroll, and a full-viewport flex layout that escapes the `MainLayout` padding

**`src/main.tsx`** — `chatRoute` registered at `/chat`.

**`src/config/applicationMenu.tsx`** — "Chat" item with `MessageSquare` icon inserted after "Plans".

Zero errors. Here's what was fixed and added:

**Bug fix — messages not rendering:**
The backend sends `{"type":"text","text":"..."}` but the code was reading `event.content`. Fixed in both `src/types/api.ts` (renamed field to `text`) and `Chat.tsx` line `accumulatedContent += event.text ?? ''`.

**Tool labels expanded:**
Added `search_knowledge_base` and `semantic_search` to the labels map, matching the actual tool names seen in your logs.

**Chart.js support:**
The AI can now return a fenced code block with language `chart` containing Chart.js-compatible JSON:

````
```chart
{
  "type": "bar",
  "data": {
    "labels": ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar"],
    "datasets": [{ "label": "PRs merged", "data": [12, 19, 8] }]
  },
  "options": { "plugins": { "title": { "display": true, "text": "Monthly PRs" } } }
}
```
````

Supported chart types: `bar`, `line`, `pie`, `doughnut`, `radar`, `polarArea`. All Chart.js components and scales are registered globally. Invalid JSON or unknown types show a graceful error message instead of crashing.
